description: Code Recon secret-detection rules. `keywords` is a cheap case-insensitive pre-filter: if none of them appear in a file, the regex is never run. `group` names the capture group holding the credential itself, which is what gets masked and fingerprinted.

rules.title: AWS access key ID
rules.remediation: Deactivate the key in IAM immediately, then remove it from the file and from git history. Use IAM roles, instance profiles, or a credential provider chain instead of static keys.

rules.title: AWS secret access key
rules.remediation: Deactivate the associated access key in IAM immediately and purge it from git history. A secret access key cannot be rotated in place - it must be replaced.

rules.title: AWS session token
rules.remediation: Session tokens are short-lived, so the urgency is lower - but committing one means the workflow that produced it is writing credentials to disk. Fix that workflow.

rules.title: GitHub personal access token
rules.remediation: Revoke at github.com/settings/tokens, then purge from history. A leaked PAT typically carries repo write access, which means supply-chain risk, not just data exposure.

rules.title: GitHub fine-grained personal access token
rules.remediation: Revoke at github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens, then purge from history.

rules.title: GitHub App private key
rules.remediation: Delete the key from the App settings and generate a new one. A GitHub App key can mint installation tokens for every repo the App is installed on.

rules.title: GitLab personal access token
rules.remediation: Revoke in GitLab under Access Tokens, then purge from history.

rules.title: Slack API token
rules.remediation: Rotate the token in the Slack app config. Bot tokens often carry channel history and file read scopes.

rules.title: Slack incoming webhook URL
rules.remediation: Anyone with this URL can post into the channel as your app. Regenerate the webhook.

rules.title: Stripe live secret key
rules.remediation: Roll the key in the Stripe dashboard now. A live secret key can move money and read full customer records.

rules.title: Stripe test secret key
rules.remediation: Test keys touch no real money, so this is hygiene rather than an incident - but the same commit habit will eventually leak a live key. Move it to an env var.

rules.title: Google API key
rules.remediation: Regenerate in the GCP console. Also add API key restrictions (HTTP referrer or IP) - unrestricted Google keys are billable by anyone who finds them.

rules.title: Google OAuth client secret
rules.remediation: Reset the client secret in the GCP credentials console.

rules.title: GCP service account key file
rules.remediation: Delete the key in IAM & Admin > Service Accounts, and audit what that account could reach. Prefer workload identity federation over key files.

rules.title: OpenAI API key
rules.remediation: Revoke at platform.openai.com/api-keys. Leaked inference keys get drained for credit within hours of hitting a public repo.

rules.title: Anthropic API key
rules.remediation: Revoke in the Anthropic Console under API keys, then purge from history.

rules.title: Private key material
rules.remediation: Treat the key as compromised: reissue it and revoke the old one. If it is a TLS key, reissue the certificate; if it is an SSH key, remove it from every authorized_keys it was installed in.

rules.title: JSON Web Token
rules.remediation: Check what the token grants and whether it has expired. A committed JWT with a long or absent exp is a live credential; a Supabase/Firebase service_role JWT bypasses row-level security entirely.

rules.title: Twilio API key or account SID
rules.remediation: Rotate in the Twilio console. Leaked messaging credentials get used for SMS pumping fraud, which is billed to you.

rules.title: SendGrid API key
rules.remediation: Delete the key in SendGrid. A leaked send key lets someone phish from your verified domain, which damages your sending reputation.

rules.title: Mailgun API key
rules.remediation: Rotate in the Mailgun control panel.

rules.title: Mailchimp API key
rules.remediation: Revoke in Mailchimp under Account > Extras > API keys. Grants access to your full audience list.

rules.title: npm access token
rules.remediation: Revoke at npmjs.com/settings/~/tokens immediately. A publish-scoped npm token is a direct supply-chain compromise vector for every package you own.

rules.title: PyPI upload token
rules.remediation: Revoke at pypi.org/manage/account/token/. Publish tokens allow releasing malicious versions of your packages.

rules.title: RubyGems API key
rules.remediation: Reset at rubygems.org/settings/edit.

rules.title: Docker Hub personal access token
rules.remediation: Revoke in Docker Hub account settings. Push access means someone can replace your images.

rules.title: DigitalOcean access token
rules.remediation: Revoke in the DigitalOcean API settings. A read-write token can create and destroy infrastructure on your account.

rules.title: Heroku API key
rules.remediation: Regenerate with `heroku authorizations:revoke`.

rules.title: Shopify access token
rules.remediation: Rotate the app credential in the Shopify admin. Storefront tokens expose order and customer data.

rules.title: Square access token
rules.remediation: Rotate in the Square developer dashboard - payment credentials.

rules.title: Braintree production access token
rules.remediation: Rotate in the Braintree control panel - production payment credentials.

rules.title: Telegram bot token
rules.remediation: Revoke with /revoke via BotFather.

rules.title: Discord bot token
rules.remediation: Regenerate the token in the Discord developer portal.

rules.title: Firebase Cloud Messaging server key
rules.remediation: Rotate the server key. It allows sending push notifications to every one of your app's users.

rules.title: Azure Storage account key
rules.remediation: Rotate the account key in the Azure portal. It grants full read/write to every blob and queue in the account - prefer SAS tokens or managed identities.

rules.title: Azure AD client secret
rules.remediation: Delete the secret in the App registration and issue a new one.

rules.title: HashiCorp Vault token
rules.remediation: Revoke with `vault token revoke`. A Vault token is a key to every other secret you own.

rules.title: Terraform Cloud API token
rules.remediation: Revoke in Terraform Cloud user settings. State files reachable with this token routinely contain other secrets.

rules.title: Notion integration token
rules.remediation: Rotate the integration secret in Notion.

rules.title: Airtable API token
rules.remediation: Revoke the token in the Airtable developer hub.

rules.title: Sentry DSN containing a secret key
rules.remediation: The legacy two-part DSN embeds a secret. Rotate the client key in Sentry and switch to the public-only DSN form.

rules.title: Cloudflare API token
rules.remediation: Roll the token in the Cloudflare dashboard. DNS edit rights allow domain takeover and certificate issuance in your name.

rules.title: Database connection string with embedded password
rules.remediation: Rotate the database password and move the URL into an environment variable or secret manager. Check whether the host is reachable from outside your network.

rules.title: Credentials embedded in a URL
rules.remediation: Credentials in a URL leak into logs, referrer headers, and shell history. Move them to a header or a credential store, and rotate.

rules.title: Hardcoded API key or token
rules.remediation: Move the value to an environment variable or secret manager and rotate it. If it was never a real credential, renaming it to something obviously fake (or adding `# coderecon:ignore[secret.generic.api-key]`) will silence this.

rules.title: Hardcoded password
rules.remediation: Read the password from configuration at runtime and rotate the current value.

rules.title: High-entropy string (possible credential)
rules.remediation: Confirm by hand whether this is a credential. It is reported at low confidence because hashes, checksums, minified identifiers, and base64-encoded assets all look like this. Suppress with `coderecon:ignore[secret.generic.high-entropy]` if it is benign.
